# Swagger Petstore

``` 1.0.7 ```

```OAS 2.0```

```[ Base URL: petstore.swagger.io/v2 ]```
[ https://petstore.swagger.io/v2/swagger.json](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")


This is a sample server Petstore server.  You can find out more about Swagger at 
[http://swagger.io](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\") or on [irc.freenode.net, #swagger](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\").  For this sample, you can use the api key `special-key` 
to test the authorization filters.

### [pet](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")


Everything about your Pets

[Find out more](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

 

POST

[/pet/{petId}/uploadImage](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

uploads an image

POST

[/pet](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Add a new pet to the store

PUT

[/pet](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Update an existing pet

GET

[/pet/findByStatus](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Finds Pets by status

GET

[/pet/findByTags](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Finds Pets by tags

GET

[/pet/{petId}](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Find pet by ID

POST

[/pet/{petId}](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Updates a pet in the store with form data

DELETE

[/pet/{petId}](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Deletes a pet

 

### [store](./swagger-ui.css " ")


Access to Petstore orders

 

GET

[/store/inventory](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Returns pet inventories by status

POST

[/store/order](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Place an order for a pet

GET

[/store/order/{orderId}](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Find purchase order by ID

DELETE

[/store/order/{orderId}](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Delete purchase order by ID

 

### [user](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")


Operations about user

[Find out more about our store](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

 

POST

[/user/createWithList](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Creates list of users with given input array

GET

[/user/{username}](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Get user by user name

PUT

[/user/{username}](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Updated user

DELETE

[/user/{username}](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Delete user

GET

[/user/login](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Logs user into the system

GET

[/user/logout](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Logs out current logged in user session

POST

[/user/createWithArray](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Creates list of users with given input array

POST

[/user](index.css "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\")

Create user
